body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Lenovo(www.lenovo) introduced 'U260', the laptop with Intel Ultrathin platform of 2nd generation at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA, for 4 days from January 6.
'U260' is loaded 12.5-inch HD LED wide display and the OS is supporting Window7. It features Intel Core i3/i5 ULV low energy consuming processor adopting new Intel Ultrathin platform.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
